ai-15.title: Bounded agent loop
ai-15.prompt: Inspect the control loop: every observation either advances a bounded step or ends the run.
ai-15.injectedEventOutcome: The repeated observation is recognized; it does not authorize an extra action.

states.label: Accept task
states.detail: Validate the requested outcome and establish the run boundary.

states.label: Observe
states.detail: Read the current fixture and record the evidence available to this step.

states.label: Choose one action
states.detail: Select a bounded action from the allowed set.

states.label: Run action
states.detail: Execute once and capture the result as an observation.

states.label: Check stop rule
states.detail: Finish when the goal is met; otherwise continue only within the budget.

states.label: Finish
states.detail: Return the outcome with evidence and a trace of the steps taken.

ai-16.title: Typed tool boundary
ai-16.prompt: Follow a tool request from schema validation through scoped execution and evidence checks.
ai-16.injectedEventOutcome: The idempotency key maps the repeated result to the prior operation; no second side effect is applied.

states.label: Read intent
states.detail: Translate the requested outcome into a narrow tool operation.

states.label: Validate arguments
states.detail: Reject missing, extra, or out-of-scope fields before execution.

states.label: Check permission
states.detail: Confirm the actor and resource scope are allowed for this operation.

states.label: Execute tool
states.detail: Perform one bounded operation and retain its operation ID.

states.label: Check evidence
states.detail: Verify the returned evidence before using it in a response.

states.label: Respond
states.detail: Report only the result supported by the verified tool output.

ai-17.title: Plan, observe, and replan
ai-17.prompt: A plan is a revisable hypothesis. Inspect the observation boundary before each next action.
ai-17.injectedEventOutcome: A duplicate observation is recorded once; it must not consume another action or change the plan twice.

states.label: Define goal
states.detail: Write an observable completion condition and a hard action budget.

states.label: Save plan
states.detail: Choose the next bounded step and record why it is expected to help.

states.label: Execute step
states.detail: Run the selected step without expanding its permissions.

states.label: Inspect result
states.detail: Compare the actual observation with the plan's assumption.

states.label: Replan or stop
states.detail: Revise only when evidence changes the next best action; stop at the budget.

states.label: Report outcome
states.detail: State what completed, what did not, and what evidence supports the report.

ai-18.title: Context selection pipeline
ai-18.prompt: Trace how task scope, evidence selection, and a bounded context produce the next model input.
ai-18.injectedEventOutcome: The evidence page is deduplicated by stable source identity before context assembly.

states.label: Resolve task
states.detail: Extract the current question and constraints that remain relevant.

states.label: Retrieve evidence
states.detail: Gather candidate passages within the caller's authorized scope.

states.label: Rank candidates
states.detail: Prefer relevant, current, and source-diverse evidence.

states.label: Fit context budget
states.detail: Keep the highest-value evidence under the input budget.

states.label: Assemble context
states.detail: Separate trusted instructions from untrusted document text.

states.label: Inspect prompt
states.detail: Check omissions and source boundaries before the model call.

ai-19.title: Checkpointed memory and artifacts
ai-19.prompt: Inspect which workflow facts belong in durable state and which can be recomputed.
ai-19.injectedEventOutcome: A stable checkpoint key makes the repeated write idempotent; the saved state remains unchanged.

states.label: Start run
states.detail: Create a run ID and initialize the durable state version.

states.label: Search docs
states.detail: Record the completed search result reference, not an unbounded prompt transcript.

states.label: Save checkpoint
states.detail: Persist state, completed step IDs, and artifact references atomically.

states.label: Interrupt safely
states.detail: Stop work after the latest committed checkpoint.

states.label: Resume run
states.detail: Reload the saved version and skip already committed effects.

states.label: Complete task
states.detail: Store the final result and terminal run status.

ai-20.title: Scoped parallel workers
ai-20.prompt: Parallel work is useful only when worker scope and merge rules are explicit.
ai-20.injectedEventOutcome: The merge layer accepts a worker result ID once and ignores the duplicate delivery.

states.label: Decompose task
states.detail: Split work into independent, reviewable scopes.

states.label: Assign worker scopes
states.detail: Give each worker explicit inputs, outputs, and write ownership.

states.label: Run workers
states.detail: Workers operate within their assigned scope and shared budget.

states.label: Collect results
states.detail: Validate worker IDs, output shape, and completion state.

states.label: Merge once
states.detail: Resolve conflicts and apply each accepted result exactly once.

states.label: Review combined work
states.detail: Check the integrated result against the original task and tests.

ai-21.title: Durable long-running workflow
ai-21.prompt: Follow a resumable task across interruption while keeping effects bounded and idempotent.
ai-21.injectedEventOutcome: The event ID is already committed; the workflow returns its recorded result without repeating the effect.

states.label: Accept job
states.detail: Persist the request, owner, deadline, and idempotency key.

states.label: Search docs
states.detail: Execute the bounded read step and retain its output reference.

states.label: Commit checkpoint
states.detail: Persist step completion before acknowledging the event.

states.label: Worker stops
states.detail: A crash ends this process; durable state remains available.

states.label: Resume from checkpoint
states.detail: A replacement worker loads the committed state and continues.

states.label: Commit completion
states.detail: Mark the result terminal exactly once and retain the audit trail.

ai-38.title: Optimistic concurrency on workflow state
ai-38.prompt: Two workers can resume from one checkpoint. A version check must prevent a stale worker from overwriting newer state.
ai-38.injectedEventOutcome: Reload the current state before trying again.

states.label: Workers read revision 4
states.detail: Workers A and B load the same state version and both prepare a next step.

states.label: Worker A commits
states.detail: A conditional write succeeds for expected revision 4 and creates revision 5.

states.label: Worker B is stale
states.detail: B still holds revision 4; applying its result would overwrite A's update.

states.label: Reject stale write
states.detail: Compare-and-swap returns a conflict; the stale update is not applied.

states.label: Reload revision 5
states.detail: B reloads current state and recomputes from the latest checkpoint.

states.label: Commit valid next state
states.detail: B can commit only against the newly observed revision.
